explanation: The author of the letter identifies himself as a servant of Jesus Christ, most likely Judas Thaddeus (brother of James), not the traditional betrayer.
Nordic translation of the Greek word 'doulos', meaning slave or submissive servant in complete devotion to the Lord.
The name of God's Son, the Messiah and Savior, where Jesus is his human name and Christ the title for the anointed King.
The term referring to Judas' kinship with James (brother of Herod) or a general designation of fellowship among believers in God's family.
An expression of love and close relationship, used here to address those who are loved by God the Father and kept by Jesus Christ.
The concept that truths of faith or prophecies have been established and made secure through God's word and actions.
The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created heaven, earth, and all life.
The term used to describe God's act of bringing the universe and everything in it into existence.
